Packaged exact checker confirms all determinant and incidence computations, \(\tau=46\) and near-free threshold; it does not pretend computational sampling proves the universal theorem.

value.rationale: The six-triple seven-line non-Fano configuration is canonically singled out in the preceding free-classification literature. Degree nine remains an active near-free classification gap. A sharp attained Tjurina threshold 46 (versus the necessary near-free minimum 47) is a natural, nonroutine exact invariant with a substantive theorem and explicit witness; it resolves precisely this hard incidence stratum without asserting general degree-nine nonexistence.
